offering_description.value: Operates and franchises Wendy's quick-service hamburger restaurants, selling burgers, chicken, fries and drinks to consumers for takeout and dine-in. Most restaurants are owned by franchisees who pay royalties and fees to the parent company.

primary_products.value: hamburgers; chicken sandwiches; french fries; breakfast items; frozen desserts

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers dining in, ordering takeout, drive-thru and delivery

end_markets.value: quick-service restaurants; food service; consumer dining

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverages sold at company-operated restaurants; licensing or royalties: royalties and franchise fees paid by franchised restaurant operators; rental or leasing: rent and property income from leased restaurant sites to franchisees
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and licenses the Wendy's brand, menu and restaurant system to franchisees; retailer: takes in food and beverage sales at company-operated restaurants and sells to consumers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and other countries, with the large majority of restaurants in the US

specialization.value: niche specialist: single quick-service hamburger restaurant brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated Wendy's restaurants; partners / resellers: franchised Wendy's restaurants operated by independent franchisees; online: mobile app and delivery platforms for ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labor, health code and franchise regulations enforced by federal, state and local agencies

notes: Franchise share of restaurants and international footprint may vary over time.
